mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use zstd as the transport compression codec, chosen because it compresses better than the codec it replaced and decompresses much faster on both ends. The recorded trade-off is that zstd is less universally supported than older codecs.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

An earlier gzip decision is on record, but the later zstd decision replaced it and nothing has retired zstd since. So I left gzip out, as you asked.
